purpose: Teach: ソヴィエト/マオリ/秦/劉/宋/萬/鵐/カキ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧ソヴィエト圏由来の事案を、警察、慎重に分析されますね
lines.en: So the police are carefully analyzing this case involving Soviet-era artifacts, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured cadence. Gentle rising inflection on the question—not challenging, genuinely curious. Pause before the final particle, as if inviting confirmation rather than demanding it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、マオリ族の文化財盗難事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: And the police also handle cases like the Māori cultural property theft incidents, don't they?
lines.style: Warm agreement, slightly affirming. Clear, steady pacing. The tone of someone building on what was just said—collaborative rather than corrective. Light warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、中国古代秦朝の遺物の真贋鑑定を、警察、依頼されますね
lines.en: So in this case, the police are being asked to authenticate Qin Dynasty artifacts from ancient China, aren't they?
lines.style: Curious but grounded. Deliberate pacing, almost methodical. Slight pause before the verb to show he's thinking through the implication. Respectful distance in the tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、漢の劉氏縁の書画の盗難事件もされますね
lines.en: And the police also handle theft investigations of Han Dynasty paintings connected to the Liu family, I understand?
lines.style: Affirming and steady. Natural rhythm of agreement. The voice of someone following the thread—present and engaged, not distant. Acknowledgment without fanfare.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、宋朝の陶磁器の盗難捜査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: So the police are conducting theft investigations of Song Dynasty ceramics in this case too, aren't they?
lines.style: Slightly more pointed but still respectful. Measured pace. The inflection carries a hint of building awareness—each case adding weight. Pause before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「萬」、つまり「万」の偽造文書も鑑定されますね
lines.en: And the police also authenticate forged documents with the old character for ten thousand—the 萬 character, in other words?
lines.style: Clear, practical tone. Speaking as though confirming a fact rather than asking a question. Steady rhythm. A note of thoroughness—listing details with precision and care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、密漁の希少鳥類、鵐、つまり鵐属の捕獲を、警察、取り締まりされますね
lines.en: So the police also crack down on the poaching of rare birds like the lesser cuckoo—the buntings in the genus Emberiza—isn't that right?
lines.style: Quieter, more intent. Slower pacing on the species name—showing care with the specificity. The tone of someone genuinely learning. Slight hesitation before the question mark, as if the detail matters.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、漁業の牡蠣、つまりカキ盗難の取り締まりもされますね
lines.en: And the police enforce regulations against oyster theft in fishing areas as well, I take it?
lines.style: Direct, practical, warm. Steady and clear. The tone of someone who has absorbed what's been shared and is offering a final confirmation without over-emphasis. Natural, conversational close.
